title: WPT model family (data/orders/<name>.json): what its sizes share, written once as the parts of a model order, then a table of its sizes; FAMILY:SIZE names one size wherever an order's name goes, and resolves to a model order the model order's schema checks

data.description: the data part every size shares, as a model order's (model.schema.json), without the settings its columns give; a size's total_tokens is the tokens it reads, and sizes whose data parts are the same but for total_tokens read the start of one corpus, of the most tokens any of them reads

model.description: the architecture's numbers every size shares, as a model order's, without the settings its columns give

seed.description: every size's seed, as a model order's

steps.description: every size's steps, as a model order's, without the settings its columns give; a step that lists stages reads the size's data.total_tokens, so its prefix_tokens is never written

drafter.description: every size's drafter, as a model order's

note.description: what the family is for, for people; every size's order holds it

branches.description: decay branches of every size, each a share of the size's updates: FAMILY:SIZE:branch-SHARE goes on from the size's trunk, its one step at the peak rate, at the last update before its first drop, and decays to its own updates (docs/model.md, "Model families"); left out, none

learning_rate_check.description: factors of the learning rate the smallest size writes: FAMILY:SIZE:lr-FACTOR is that size's own run at FACTOR times it (docs/model.md, "Model families"); left out, none

sizes.description: the table of sizes: one row per size, one column per setting that varies between sizes; a setting no column names is common, and a setting is written in one place only

columns.description: "size", then the path of each setting that varies: its names from the top of a model order joined by '.', the steps numbered from 1 (model.d_model, data.total_tokens, data.vocabulary, steps.1.optimizer.settings.lr)

rows.description: one per size: its name (what FAMILY:SIZE names), then its value for each other column, in order, none left empty
